VISTAMATIONS COMMAND LIST
SUBJECT: Console Commands & Agent Protocols

================================================================================

All manual inputs and console interactions on the Command Control and terminal interfaces must use the "x" prefix syntax instead of industry-standard backslash or slash characters.

1. DIRECT COMMAND LIST
----------------------
* xinitiate [agent] [job/task]
  - DESCRIPTION: The primary execution command for any agent job, workflow, or system task.
  - FIRST PROTOCOL RULE: When you command "xinitiate", the assigned agent must strictly execute the four-stage execution loop:
    1. REVIEW (Read the request and analyze the exact file boundaries).
    2. VALIDATE (Check dependencies, permissions, and parameters on the local host).
    3. VERIFY (Perform the action and inspect terminal outputs/test runs).
    4. CONFIRM (Assert status in the local ledger, write file state, and report back).

* xstatus [service]
  - DESCRIPTION: Polls the real-time API status of the specified service, bypassing process-existence indicators.

* xtelemetry
  - DESCRIPTION: Forces an immediate 10-second AJAX update cycle on Command Control to synchronize status dots.

* xsync
  - DESCRIPTION: Triggers the OpenClaw /olivia/respond queue watcher to push and pull pending JSON tasks to disk.

* xclear
  - DESCRIPTION: Runs the message buffer compression algorithm, clearing logs down to the last 5 active items.

* xpair [channel] [pairing-code]
  - DESCRIPTION: Registers and approves an external client channel (such as Telegram) with OpenClaw.

* xhelp
  - DESCRIPTION: Prints this command reference list directly in the terminal interface.

================================================================================
